# Vestra Player SDK

> @vestra-player/sdk 1.5.14: write plugins for Vestra Player in TypeScript (plugin API `vestra/1`). A plugin is a folder with `manifest.json` and an entry module whose default export `activate(plugin)` the player calls; it runs in its own Node.js process. Everything a plugin creates (commands, windows, panels, filters, listeners…) is a handle that is released automatically when the plugin stops. L<n> are line numbers in llms-full.txt, next to this file: every page, declaration and example.

**Rules**

- **Only the public SDK.** Import `@vestra-player/sdk` with `import type` only (a runtime import fails `vestra-plugin build`) and `@vestra-player/sdk/testing` only in tests.
- **No other plugins.** Do not import another plugin's code, read its directory or data directory, or talk to it privately (shared files, sockets, messages).
- **No system commands.** Do not run `open`, `sips`, `plutil`, `security`, `cmd`, `powershell` or similar.
- **macOS and Windows.** The same code runs on both: build paths with `node:path`, write package paths with `/`, and handle `unsupported` where a method documents a platform difference.
- **Your own id.** `<owner>.<name>`, where the owner is your GitHub user or organization.

**Files**

```text
my-plugin/
  manifest.json        identity and capabilities
  main.ts              the entry module
  ui/hello.slint       optional: user interface
  tests/main.test.ts   tests (node:test)
  package.json         dev dependency and scripts
```

**manifest.json**

```json
{
  "id": "me.hello",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "apiVersion": "vestra/1",
  "entry": "main.ts",
  "capabilities": ["commands", "ui.osd", "playback.read", "events"]
}
```

Fields: `id`, `version`, `apiVersion`, `entry`, `capabilities`, `name`, `author`, `punchline`, `description`, `tags`, `icon`, `readme`, `changelog`, `sourceUrl`, `license`, `minPlayerVersion`; unknown fields and capabilities are rejected. Rules and limits: L2073–2135.

**main.ts**

```ts
import type { Plugin } from "@vestra-player/sdk";

export default async function activate(plugin: Plugin) {
  plugin.commands.add({
    id: "hello",
    path: ["Tools", "Hello"],
    run: () => plugin.osd.show("Hello"),
  });
}
```

**Capabilities** (a call without one fails with `capability`)

- `producer.av`: Player.openStream (also `playback.control`)
- `playback.read`: Player.state/refresh/stats/chapters/audioDevices, Timeline.marks
- `playback.control`: Player.open/setPaused/seek/setRate/restart/close/scrub/setOutput/provideSequence/next/previous/addAudioTrack/selectAudioTrack/step/setStepSeek/setLoop/setAudioDevice, Power.preventSleep
- `source.resolve`: Resolvers.add
- `events`: Player/Subtitles/Timeline/MainWindow/Appearance/PanelSlot/Panel/BackdropSlot.onChange, Resolvers.onFileTypesChange
- `commands`: Commands.add, Host.run
- `ui.window`: Windows.create
- `ui.mount`: Panels.mount/bottom/sidebar/backdrop, PanelSlot/Panel/BackdropSlot.onChange
- `ui.dialog`: Dialogs.confirm/openFile/openFiles/openDirectory/saveFile
- `plugins.manage`: Packages.validate/validateArchive/rollback/setEnabled/uninstall
- `processing.video`: Plugin.video.filter/video.view/video.render (also `playback.read`)
- `processing.audio`: Plugin.audio.filter (also `playback.read`, `events`)
- `subtitles.read`: Subtitles.state/onChange/refresh
- `subtitles.control`: Subtitles.select/load/remove/setStyle
- `media.read`: MediaCapture.capture, Snapshot.export (also `media.control`)
- `media.control`: MediaCapture.capture, Snapshot.export (also `media.read`)
- `ui.osd`: Osd.show/panel
- `clipboard`: Clipboard.readText/writeText/writeImage
- `window.control`: MainWindow.setVideoArea/setAlwaysOnTop/setCursorAutoHide/setPictureInPicture
- `bindings.manage`: Bindings.list/set/reset/onChange
- `timeline.marks`: Timeline.layer
- `ui.drop`: Drops.provide, Panel.onDrop
- `ui.settings`: Settings.page/show
- `ui.theme`: Appearance.set/setLanguage
- `secrets`: Secrets.get/set/delete
- No capability: `tools`, `storage`, `system`, `app`, `ui` (images and Markdown), `i18n`, reading window.state, appearance.theme and packages.list. Details: L2136–2178.

**Test**: `tests/*.test.ts` with `node:test`, run by `vestra-plugin test`. `startPlugin(activate, { directory: new URL("..", import.meta.url) })` from `@vestra-player/sdk/testing` returns `{ host, stop }`; `host` is a TestHost (an in-memory player): `host.setSource(…)`, `host.command(id).run()`, `host.press(key)`, `await host.settle()`, then assert on `host.osd`, `host.window(id).props`… Guide: L1635–1800; TestHost: L6684.

**Command line**

- `vestra-plugin check`: strict type check of the plugin's .ts files and tests/*.ts
- `vestra-plugin build`: check, then write dist/
- `vestra-plugin test`: node --test on tests/*.test.{ts,mjs}
- `vestra-plugin pack`: build, then dist/ → <out>/<id>-<version>.vxp
- `vestra-plugin i18n extract`: find the texts to translate, write locales/messages.pot and merge it into every locales/<lang>.po
- `vestra-plugin i18n check`: coverage per language, placeholder and plural problems, a stale messages.pot
- `vestra-player --plugin <dir>` runs a plugin from source, no build needed.

**Error codes** (`error.code`; branch on it, never on `message`)

- `stale`: A condition no longer held
- `capability`: The manifest does not declare the capability the call needs
- `invalid`: A bad argument
- `missing`: The target does not exist
- `busy`: The player is still doing a previous call of the same kind
- `conflict`: Another plugin owns the resource
- `unavailable`: Not possible right now
- `unsupported`: Not possible on this system, build or source
- `failed`: The operation ran and failed
- `aborted`: An `AbortSignal` fired
- `timeout`: A time limit ran out
- `limit`: A player-wide limit was reached, a property value is over the limits of PropValue
- `reserved`: The id is `vestra` or starts with `vestra.`
- `versionMismatch`: The package needs a newer player or another `apiVersion`
- Others: PluginError, llms-full.txt L3062.

## API

Where each module of `plugin` (`plugin.<module>`) is declared:

- Plugin L3241, Scope L3110, PluginError L3062, Disposable L3035
- Commands L3453; Windows L3658; Panels L4299; Dialogs L4585; Player L5026; video: VideoFilter L5291, VideoView L5354, RenderOptions L5396; audio: AudioFilter L5315; Subtitles L5494; media: MediaCapture L5654; Resolvers L5759; Packages L5999; Osd L5227; Host L5175; Clipboard L6116; Power L6136; Tools L6169; Storage L6212; System L6235; Secrets L6253; window: MainWindow L4422; App L4503; Bindings L6086; Ui L3545; Timeline L4379; Drops L3955; Appearance L3984; I18n L4126; Settings L4232.

## Examples

Tested plugins in [examples/](https://github.com/vestrasys/vestra-player-sdk/tree/main/examples):

- hello: The README Quick start: one menu command and an on-screen message. L8243–8332
- blur: A tool window with one slider that blurs the playing video. L8333–8594
- signal-generator: Generates its own video and audio: colour bars and a 1 kHz tone. L8595–8927
- bookmark: A tool window bound to the playback state: remember the position and jump back to it. L8928–9112
- panel-menu: A sidebar panel with its own right-click menu. L9113–9318
- menus: Radio menu items, separator groups and a menu item whose title changes. L9319–9478
- theme-widgets: A tool window drawn with the player's theme and widgets. L9479–9642
- markdown: A window that shows a Markdown document. L9643–9837
- i18n: A plugin in the player's language: English source text, a Chinese translation. L9838–10005
